candidates.description: This feature vector represents concepts related to societal, cultural, and structural domains of human organization and activity.
This feature vector represents common Italian grammatical words, pronouns, and prepositions.
This vector activates for prefixes, suffixes, and roots of words related to society, social systems, and interpersonal relations.
This vector activates on words, roots, and prefixes related to travel, exploration, or organized group outings.
This vector represents Italian interrogative and relative pronouns, conjunctions, and common wh-words.
These tokens represent Latin-derived verbal roots and prefixes associated with relationships, consistency, and logical connection.
This vector activates subword tokens frequently associated with the root "medi-" and related terms involving middle, medium, or mediation.
The feature vector activates tokens related to the prefix "ass-" and its variations, alongside words and roots associated with systems and associations.
This vector represents adjectives and verbs describing scale, variety, quality, or degree.
This feature activates on words and word fragments containing the suffixes "-ission", "-ension", or "-pression", often associated with nouns ending in similar phonetic structures.
